description_en: Queries the request count, error count, and average response time of each API in an application by page. You can check the Completed field in the response to determine whether pagination has ended. If pagination has not ended, increment the CurrentPage parameter by one and continue querying
description_zh: 通过分页的形式查询应用下每个接口的请求量、错误数、平均响应时间三种性能数据。可通过返回信息中的Completed字段判断分页是否结束。如未结束，CurrentPage参数加一后继续发起查询即可
kebab_example: aliyun arms get-app-api-by-page --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --pid a2n80plglh@745eddxxx --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAppApiByPage

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number of the query results
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: This parameter is no longer supported. The number of items per page in the query results. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 此参数已不支持使用。查询结果的每页项目数量。默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The time interval of data slices, in milliseconds. Minimum value: 60000. Maximum value: 2147483647
parameters.help_zh: 数据片的时间间隔，单位为毫秒，最小值为60000，最大值为2147483647
parameters.name: interval_mills

parameters.help_en:
The application ID.

In the Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS) console, choose Application Monitoring > Application List and click the target application name. The URL in the browser address bar contains the PID of the application in the pid=xxx format. Because the browser encodes the URL, you must modify the PID. For example, if the PID in the URL is xxx%4074xxx, replace %40 with @. The PID is xxx@74xxx
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

在ARMS控制台的应用监控>应用列表页面单击目标应用名称。此时浏览器地址栏中的URL即包含应用的pid，格式为pid=xxx。由于浏览器进行了编码，因此需要对pid稍作修改。例如，如果URL中包含的pid为xxx%4074xxx，则需要将%40替换为@，即：xxx@74xxx
parameters.name: pid

Code.description_en:

2XX: Success.
3XX: Redirection.
4XX: Request error.
5XX: Server error
Code.description_zh:
接口状态。

2XX：成功。

5XX：服务器错误

Completed.description_en:
Indicates whether paging is complete.

true: Paging is complete.
false: Paging is not complete. Increment CurrentPage by one and continue querying
Completed.description_zh:
分页查询是否结束。

true：结束。
false：需要继续分页（CurrentPage+1后继续查询）
